assets.subject: a round woven rattan serving tray with a fresh green banana leaf on it and one empty white ceramic plate in the middle
assets.details: Seen from slightly above, the same angle as a café counter. The plate is plain, glossy and empty, with a soft rim, sitting on the banana leaf so the leaf peeks out around it; the tray is warm honey rattan with a neat woven rim. Nothing on the plate, no food, no cutlery, no words.
